answer: An operator that abandons 164 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the harbor forfeiture publishes up in the timber totals with the gale audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 11% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
